meta.name: Love Adhura
meta.description:
A simple guy meets a charming damsel who cons him out of his car, leading to unexpected twists and dramatic consequences involving his overbearing father and a staged romance at their resort.

Complete series. On your server: S1 4/4

videos.title: Kaun Hai Yeh Ladki
videos.overview: Sumit, A simple unassuming guy gives Nandita, a damsel in distress a lift and gets conned out of his vintage car in the bargain. But she's not the only one after the car.

videos.title: Ek Nayi Original Kahaani
videos.overview: Sumit finds Nandita and hires her for a job in lieu of turning her in to the police. The job is to convince his overbearing father that she's his girlfriend but he finds himself falling for her.

videos.title: Teri Meri Puraani Yaadein
videos.overview: Nandita realises that there are sinister events unfolding in and around the car and there are more players involved while Sumit remains blissfully unaware. Though Nandita's job is over, Sumit has fallen in love and doesn't want her to go.

videos.title: Safarnama Ka Aakhri Chapter
videos.overview: With the job now over, reluctantly, Sumit and Nandita decide to part ways, but not before one last con.
